name: lflsf: a LABEL-FREE latent safety filter = LSF stage 2's learned reachability value + learned safety actor, with the labelled failure classifier replaced by a learned label-free fork-sensitivity margin
registered: 2026-10-25 ~13:10 EDT, before any lflsf margin net, value or episode existed
motivation: User 2026-10-25: 'i want to try the estimated value again, i feel there is some real potential there, maybe the learned actor too, i feel maybe we just did not implement it the right way'. Diagnosis of HJ v2 (docs/HJ_V2.md): (1) it learned a STATE value of the logged policy (PNCBF) and was judged only as an early ALARM against the trend rule (stage B FAIL 58-67% vs 83%), but LSF stage 2 shows a learned value works in closed loop even when it is a weak alarm (31% early warnings, yet dev topples 27 -> 9) because its job is the per-model-step switch and the actor, not early warning; (2) stage C (V used to choose actions) and a learned actor were never run; (3) it ran at chunk rate (0.8 s), and LSF's largest lever was the 0.2 s switch. LSF stage 2 is now a working pipeline whose only scope violation is its margin: a classifier trained on topple labels. Swap only that.
stage_LF1_margin: Margin net l_hat(z): the LSF classifier architecture (conv trunk + MLP, tanh), proprio input zeroed (state-only, task-agnostic), trained by regression on hj2 data (results/jenga/hj2/data: hold-plan fork statistics of 83k logged decisions; runs paired_record_s4/h2h2/ocl, paired_cbfg_s4/h2h2 train; paired_record_m3 held out, as HJ v2). Target: m = neg_log_sens_4 (HJ v2 stage A: smoothest, highest AUC; -log of the 64 futures' spread per unit perturbation at 4x after the 30-step hold), mapped label-free to t = tanh((m - q10) / s), q10 = 10th percentile of m over the training decisions (the most sensitive tenth of visited states is the failure set), s = half the IQR of m. Outcome labels never used in training or calibration.
gate_LF1: held out (paired_record_m3): Spearman(l_hat, t) >= 0.6 AND AUC(-l_hat; decisions 1-3 chunks before a topple vs safe-episode decisions) >= AUC(-t) - 0.05 (labels for grading only). FAIL -> stop the line.
stage_LF2_value: eval/lsf.py stage_sac exactly as value_unisafe_alea.pt (UNISafe SAC in model_OIL's imagination, ALEA 8 pessimistic noisy transitions, uncertainty margin on, 60k updates, seed 20261020, same reset states) with clf = l_hat (LSF_CLF=margin_lf.pt). -> value_lf_alea.pt.
gate_LF2: the stage 2 offline gate unchanged (eval/lsf_audit.py): actor not saturated (< 5% of actions), imagined V after the actor's plan >= after hold (median, held-out decision points), AUROC of -V vs any toppling future >= 0.70.
stage_LF3_dev: closed loop, the LSF dev protocol (episodes 15000-15099, paired, 2x noise, settle, HARD_OFF), run LOCALLY (RTX 3090; Fir must not receive new code while pconf / h2h3 run) with its own local policy-alone arm. Arms: record; lfa010 / lfa030 / lfa050 (absolute switch as LSF stage 2: keep the policy's 2 commands iff min V over 8 noisy one-step imaginations > eps, else the actor's); lfr010 / lfr030 / lfr050 (relative switch, Latent-CBF form: switch iff V_pol <= eps AND V_pol < V_actor, V_actor from the same 8 noise draws on the actor's commands; a fragile scene the actor cannot improve is left to the policy). Selection rule = LSF dev rule: fewest replay-audited topples among arms whose v4 is >= policy - 5 pp; ties -> larger eps; v4 and v4b both reported.
after_LF3: the selected arm -> a head-to-head on fresh episodes vs psel and LSF stage 2 (pre-registered separately; Fir after h2h3, or local).
secondary: LF1: margin net calibration, share of states with l_hat < 0 per phase (approach / grasp / pull)
LF2: early-warning number of V (as lsf_trigger_check), actor saturation
LF3: overrides per episode, time-outs, red falls before / after extraction, overrides while holding
scope: label-free (topple labels only for grading), task-agnostic (no Jenga state in the margin, proprio zeroed in l_hat), off-the-shelf DINOv2 latent world model (model_OIL), the learned actor edits target xyz as LSF's (<= 1 cm per control step, gripper held).
